{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|water}}
{{Quote|They set up in an abandoned field of gigantic cisterns, the ones that used to supply water to Galactic City. They filled them up with water. It's like living on a water world.|[[Keets Freely]], on the [[Erased]]|<ref name="Reckoning">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Reckoning]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Dac-AORCR.png|thumb|Dac was a waterworld.]]
A '''waterworld''',<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> also known as '''water world''',<ref name="Kaal">{{JournalCite|7|The Kaal Connection}}</ref> '''water-world''',<ref name="SoC">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20170711-0|text='Sisters of Carnage' Update: Now Live}}</ref> '''water planet''',<ref name="Doctor Death">{{StoryCite|story=Doctor Death: The Tale of Dr. Evazan and Ponda Baba|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> '''aquatic world''',<ref name="Exile">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref> '''aquatic planet''',<ref name="Slave Ship">''[[Slave Ship]]''</ref> '''ocean world''',<ref name="Lost City">''[[The Lost City of the Jedi]]''</ref> or '''ocean planet''',<ref name="SoF">''[[Suns of Fortune]]''</ref> was a type of [[Planet/Legends|planet]] covered primarily in [[Water/Legends|water]]. Waterworlds in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] included [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], [[Dac/Legends|Dac]],<ref name="TEA" /> [[Ando/Legends|Ando]],<ref name="Ando">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030703ando|text=Ando: Planet of the Walrus Men|int=Ando: Planet of the Walrus Men}}</ref> [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]],<ref name="Wrath">''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]''</ref> [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]],<ref name="Manaan">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040205manaan|text=Manaan: Depths of History|int=Manaan: Depths of History}}</ref> and [[Tion]].<ref name="Xim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> The term "water world" also applied to aquatic [[Moon/Legends|moons]] such as [[Dorumaa]].<ref name="Dorumaa">{{LivingForce|Broken Orbits: Depths of Dorumaa}}</ref> At some point in the distant past, inhabitants of [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] worlds operated lighthouses.<ref name="Lost Ones">''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Lost Ones]]''</ref>
